Method-shopping controls, artifact paths, AX-001 interpretation, and PG2 sequential-admission evidence are not audit-ready.

critical_concerns.description: The required qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-P20260509_002/weights.csv is absent, and the available stage file is as_of_date,sleeve,weight rather than as_of_date,ticker,weight,method_selected. KR_10y is a single ETF sleeve with max weight 0.3286049995, breaching the 0.20 single-asset cap.

Method-shopping control fails: 12 methods were evaluated despite the <=10 candidate cap, DSR is still marked N=10, and best_method_recommendation.json reports WF_DRO_W_eps0.1 while its rationale fields come from the top-ranked WF_MV_lambda2 row.
Selected method has IR_vs_S0 = -1.511 and CAGR 19.93% versus alpha-only S0 CAGR 40.21%, yet no TDC vs PG2, replacement scenario, or integration scenario is reported.
AX-001 v2 is redefined at portfolio level by dropping the required bad/normal IC ratio; the package calls it diagnostic-only even though AX-001 v2 makes conditional defense metrics mandatory.

The user-specified alpha_scores.parquet and covariance.parquet under qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-P20260509_002 are missing, so WT-specific alpha time-series, PSD, and condition-number <=100 post-shrink claims cannot be verified.

RF-A1/RF-R6 alignment is not evidenced: alpha/risk packages are stubs, Hill alpha is absent, and crisis fallback does not shrink boundaries to 0.10 or activate a cash sleeve because Cash UB is forced to zero.

Charter 8 No Silent Override is incomplete: an infeasibility_report exists for schedule density, but optimizer_challenge_note.md is absent and the draft package does not list the infeasibility report as a generated artifact.

supporting_arguments: The available hyphen-stage weights file has 195 monthly dates from 2010-02-01 to 2026-04-01, long-only weights, and per-date sleeve sums equal to 1.0.
Selected turnover is 10.04% annual and MDD is 11.07%, both below the stated hard fails.

The inherited alpha_scores path stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_010/alpha_scores.parquet is time-series shaped with 268 dates and Date/Ticker columns, but it is not the WT-specific artifact requested for this critique.
R code uses a rolling t-60 to t-1 window, so the intended PIT design is plausible, but artifact and schema defects prevent approval.
unresolved_disputes: Can sleeve-level weights be admitted, or must the optimizer deliver ticker-level holdings under max_names <=20 and max_w <=0.20?
Is A148070/KR_10y admissible under the stated KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150 universe mandate?
Should the first 73 alpha dates be excluded, or should Forge receive an explicit alpha-only fallback schedule?
What is TDC versus PG2/MEGA_05, and how do replacement and integration scenarios perform?
weakest_assumption: A 4-sleeve schedule with a 50% sleeve cap can substitute for ticker-level KR hard-constraint weights while allocating 21.36% to 32.86% to the single KR_10y ETF.
rebuttal_required: Provide ticker-level weights.csv at the required mailbox path with as_of_date,ticker,weight,method_selected.
Prove every date satisfies max_names <=20, 0 <= w_i <=0.20, sum weights =1, and A148070 <=0.20.
Re-run or justify method selection under candidates_tried <=10; fix DSR multi-trial N and best_method_recommendation.json.
Provide WT-specific covariance artifact with PSD and condition-number <=100 post-shrink verification.
Provide Hill alpha/RF-R6 evidence and the heavy-tail tie-break rule outcome.
Report TDC vs PG2 plus replacement and integration scenario metrics.
